fusions.name: Bow Wave
fusions.desc: Pushes a swell that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, knocks it back 2.5 tiles and leaves it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wedge Formation
fusions.desc: Sends 3 swells out in a wedge, each of which deals 12 damage. Your allies deal 15% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Undertow
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you surface 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Riding High
fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your health regenerates 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
